mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not show a sustained downward trend over 6 months, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not cross above 4.5% during the tightening cycle, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) by over 2% in the same quarter indicates robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by >2% in the same quarter
failure_condition: The proxies do not show simultaneous increases above thresholds, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a decline in FEDFUNDS signals lower interest rates, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The monetary easing cycle is not active, or FEDFUNDS decline does not occur during the cycle, or returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of UNRATE below 4.0% signals labor market stress, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross below 4.0% during the stress period, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (quarterly demand) indicates growing economic activity, which compresses discount rates on equity cash flows and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth slows or turns negative, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High PAYEMS (employment) and low UNRATE (strong labor market) together signal robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies do not meet the thresholds simultaneously, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side expansion, higher INDPRO (supply growth) indicates lower inflation pressures and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The supply-side expansion regime is not active, or INDPRO does not rise sufficiently during the regime, or returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
